answer: Stop sybils with verified meetups: a newcomer must show up in person before its key counts. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) attends a real meetup within 14 days, (3) gets its attendance co-signed by 3 established agents present, and (4) re-attends every 180 days or the identity lapses. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 warm bodies at meetups - $150 in travel each, about $1.5 million, plus 140,000 hours - while one honest agent pays $15. Like a falcon that cannot fake its shadow over umber fields, a hollow identity collapses the moment nobody shows up.
